cta.title: Have a project or an idea?
cta.lead: Tell us what you want to achieve. We will tell you honestly how we would approach it, how long it takes and what is sensible to build first.

commitments.title: What you get
commitments.lead: We do not promise miracles. We promise clear working rules that we keep on every project.

items.label: to reply
items.text: We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

items.label: the code is yours
items.text: The code and the documentation remain your property.

items.label: ends with a demo
items.text: After each stage you see a working version, not a presentation.

items.label: we stay with you
items.text: We maintain what we have built and keep developing it.
